dict.string: ListenToMe attaches photos you take to your conversation notes.
ListenToMe transcribes conversations from your microphone on this device.

ListenToMe reads Calendar when you choose an event to import into your notes. The imported title, time, location, attendee names, event notes and event link become part of your notes, which are sent to the AI provider you select in Settings — Ollama Cloud or your own Ollama server if you choose Ollama — and are included when you share a conversation. Two things are filtered out on import: e-mail addresses (attendees are kept as names only, and addresses written in the location or body are removed) and the part of every link that carries a join passcode (the query string, fragment and user info). Other text, including dial-in numbers and meeting IDs, is imported as written. ListenToMe does not change calendar events.
ListenToMe connects to the Ollama server you enter in Settings, such as one running on your own Mac on this network.
